ui.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ui.verifyNote: This is information, not an official decision. Please confirm on the official site or at your nearest office.
home.eyebrow: KNOW YOUR RIGHTS · FIND YOUR BENEFITS
home.title2: you can get, in your own language.
home.sub: Answer a few simple questions by voice or by tapping. We show the schemes you may qualify for, the papers you need and the next step. Free. No Aadhaar or bank details needed.
home.route.title: Three ways to start
home.route1.d: Answer 7 easy questions. See which schemes you may get, and why.
home.route2.d: Take a photo or paste a government letter. Get a simple summary, the deadline and what to do.
home.route3.d: Paste a message or link about a scheme. We show warning signs and whether the link is official.
home.how.title: How it works
home.how1.d: Use your voice in English, Hindi or Telugu. No typing needed.
home.how2.d: Eligibility is worked out by fixed rules and shown with reasons. AI only explains in plain words.
home.how3.d: See documents to collect, how to apply and the official link. Print your application packet.
home.trust.title: Built to be trusted
home.trust1: Every scheme links to its official source
home.trust2: Near misses show what is missing, for example an income certificate
home.trust3: We never ask for Aadhaar, bank or card numbers
home.trust4: Your answers stay in this browser. One tap deletes them
home.sample: Scheme rules in this prototype are simplified screening rules. Always confirm on the official portal.
check.title: Check my benefits
check.intro: We ask one question at a time. You can answer by tapping or by speaking.
check.consent.title: Before we start
check.consent.body: We will ask a few simple questions about you. We do not ask for Aadhaar, bank or card numbers. Your answers stay in this browser and are not saved on our server. You can delete them any time.
check.noVoice: Voice input is not supported on this browser. Please tap an answer.
check.notHeard: I could not understand. Please try again or tap an answer.
check.gender: Are you a man or a woman?
check.area: Do you live in a village or a town or city?
check.income: About how much does your family earn in a year?
check.disability: Does anyone in your family have a disability that is certified or recognised?
results.title: Your results
results.sub: Based on the answers you gave. Tap a scheme to see documents and how to apply.
results.value: Estimated yearly value of cash benefits you may get
results.valueNote: Only schemes with a fixed yearly amount are counted.
results.deleted: Your answers were deleted from this browser.
results.empty: Answer the questions first to see your results.
results.summaryLine: {e} may qualify, {a} almost, {n} not a match
reason.AGE_MIN.ok: Your age meets the minimum ({min} years or more)
reason.AGE_MIN.fail: You need to be at least {min} years old
reason.AGE_MIN.unknown: Minimum age is {min}. Tell us your age to check
reason.AGE_MAX.ok: Your age is within the limit (up to {max} years)
reason.AGE_MAX.unknown: Age limit is {max}. Tell us your age to check
reason.INCOME_MAX.ok: Your family income is within the limit (up to ₹{max} a year)
reason.INCOME_MAX.fail: Your family income looks above the limit (₹{max} a year)
reason.INCOME_MAX.unknown: Income limit is about ₹{max} a year. Bring an income certificate to confirm
reason.OCCUPATION.unknown: This scheme is for: {list}. Tell us your work to check
reason.GENDER.unknown: This scheme is for: {value}. Tell us to check
reason.AREA.ok: This scheme is for people living in: {value}
reason.AREA.fail: This scheme is only for people living in: {value}
reason.AREA.unknown: This scheme is for: {value}. Tell us where you live
reason.LAND.ok: You own farm land, which this scheme needs
reason.LAND.fail: This scheme needs farm land in your name
reason.LAND.unknown: This scheme needs farm land. Tell us if you own land
reason.DISABILITY.ok: A recognised disability is needed and you said yes
reason.DISABILITY.fail: This scheme is for people with a recognised disability
reason.DISABILITY.unknown: This scheme needs a recognised disability. Tell us to check
scheme.docsHint: Tap each one when you have it.
scheme.unverified: Prototype rules: confirm every detail on the official site before you apply.
scheme.title: Explore schemes
scheme.sub: Every scheme links to its official source.
scam.title: Is this message real?
scam.intro: Paste a message, link or phone number about a scheme. We show warning signs. This is a guide, not a final verdict.
scam.advice.LOW: No strong warning signs found. Still, confirm on the official website before you share anything.
scam.advice.MEDIUM: Some warning signs. Do not pay or share details. Check the scheme on its official site.
scam.advice.HIGH: Do not click links, pay money or share OTP, PIN or bank details. Real government schemes do not ask for fees to give you a benefit.
scam.reason.SHORT_LINK: A shortened link hides where it really goes ({host})
scam.reason.GOV_LOOKALIKE: The link looks like a government site but is not one ({host})
scam.reason.NON_OFFICIAL_LINK: The link is not a government website ({host})
scam.reason.FEE_DEMAND: It asks you to pay a fee or send money
scam.reason.OTP_PIN: It asks you to share an OTP, PIN or password
scam.reason.APK: It asks you to install an app or file
scam.reason.PRIZE: It promises a prize, lottery or free gift
scam.reason.URGENCY: It creates pressure to act very fast
scam.reason.KYC_LINK: It asks for an Aadhaar or KYC update through a link
scam.reason.PERSONAL_NUMBER: It asks you to contact a personal phone number
scam.reason.OFFICIAL_LINKS: All links go to official government sites
notice.title: Understand a notice
notice.intro: Take a clear photo of a government letter, or paste its text. We explain it in simple words. Always confirm at the office that sent it.
notice.subject: What it is about
notice.lowConf: We are not sure about this reading. Please confirm at the office that sent the notice.
notice.privacy: Your photo is used only to read the notice and is not kept.
ask.title: Ask a question
ask.intro: Ask about any scheme in your own words. Answers come only from our scheme directory. Do not share Aadhaar, bank details or passwords.
ask.placeholder: For example: How can my daughter get a scholarship?
footer.text: Adhikar Setu · Information support for public services. Not a government website. Verify details with official sources.
